data.one_liner: A customizable blob wave animation widget that can react to audio amplitude.
data.what_it_does: The package supplies a WaveBlob widget that draws a moving, blob‑shaped wave. You can adjust color, speed, radius and optionally drive the animation with audio amplitude. It works on all major Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need a simple, eye‑catching wave animation around a widget
You want an audio‑reactive visual effect without writing custom drawing code
avoid_when: Performance‑critical apps where custom GPU shaders are needed
strengths: Very easy to integrate via a single widget
Works on Android, iOS, web, desktop out of the box
weaknesses: No built‑in audio capture; you must supply amplitude values
